def Lean.SourceInfo.getPos? : SourceInfo → optParam Bool false → Option String.Pos.Raw :=
fun info canonicalOnly =>
  match info, canonicalOnly with
  | SourceInfo.original leading pos trailing endPos, x => some pos
  | SourceInfo.synthetic pos endPos true, x => some pos
  | SourceInfo.synthetic pos endPos canonical, false => some pos
  | x, x_1 => none
